overview_description.description: Forter is a company that delivers real-time, completely automated, fraud prevention solutions for online merchants. It creates a completely fraud-free environment for the retailers through which they have the ability to make decisions that are solely based on what is good for their business. The company’s system is designed to be consumer-centric, blocking fraud with accuracy, and at the same time enabling growth by increasing approvals and ensuring a better customer experience.

about_short_description.short_description: Forter is a software-as-a-service company that delivers real-time, automated, fraud prevention solutions for online merchants.

product.name: Fraud Management
product.description: Real-time fraud decisioning that identifies trusted customers, blocks fraudulent transactions, and applies consistent controls across cards, wallets, BNPL, ACH, gift cards, and other payment methods.

product.name: Payment Optimization
product.description: Payment decisioning and orchestration tools that improve authorization rates, reduce payment costs, apply intelligent 3DS, and manage routing, exemptions, tokenization, and processor connectivity.

product.name: Account Protection
product.description: Account security controls that detect account takeover, fake and duplicate account creation, incentive abuse, and risky account activity while limiting unnecessary authentication for trusted users.

product.name: Abuse Prevention
product.description: Policy-abuse detection that identifies repeat and coordinated misuse of promotions, returns, referrals, loyalty programs, and other customer policies while preserving legitimate customer access.

product.name: Dispute Management
product.description: Automated chargeback and refund decisioning that prioritizes disputes, assembles evidence, supports representment, and uses dispute alerts to reduce avoidable chargeback losses.

product.name: Forter Element for PSPs
product.description: A fraud decisioning solution for payment service providers that enables automated merchant risk decisions, reporting, 3DS optimization, and optional chargeback guarantees through a single integration.
